entries.reason: The source strategy at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:1-8 is explicitly fetch/viem-mocked with a fixed test key, while LeverupBroker.ts:1-9 is only a module comment; it cannot prove remote acceptance or poll timing. The repaired entry confines this to typed fixture decoding and deterministic planning, uses an isolated SQLite journal/scheduler plus remote ledger only for controlled restart scenarios, and keeps real-broker acceptance, compensation, redaction, and baseline evidence as separate gates.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:10-18 constructs legacy Contract/Order values and embeds TEST_PRIVATE_KEY/TEST_TRADER_ADDRESS. The repair keeps those vectors at a compatibility boundary, adds explicit scope/instrument/unit constructors, and makes signer access an effect-only fixture; serialized signatures and complete native request bodies remain redacted/digest evidence rather than key-bearing domain values.

The viem mock at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:20-34 independently returns chain 10143, a six-decimal 1000-USDC balance, and decimals 6. The repaired analysis compares observed chain/token/agent/address-set evidence before Money or SigningDomain binding, with a different token address and chainId as concrete mismatches rather than readiness.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:36-48 restores global fetch and imports native helpers directly, so a passing test does not identify an owned effect boundary. The repair uses declared endpoint ports, injected clock/nonce, and a scoped finalizer; route mismatch and concurrent fixture scopes now fail independently of business outcomes.

MockFetchOptions at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:50-59 combines optional Pyth, positions, submit errors, and status booleans, allowing unrelated inputHash/status or schema-less rows. The repaired discriminated scenarios require endpoint correlation and exact reader/status codecs; malformed bodies become protocol violations and never success=false.

installFetchMock at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:61-116 routes by URL substring, always emits reader page 0, casts JSON, and maps status through executed/success booleans. The repair adds method/path/body/response decoding, page coverage, and phase-aware status evidence; a two-page response, malformed status, and post-DispatchStarted 503 have distinct conservative outcomes.

The beforeEach/afterEach hooks at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:118-125 only install/restore global fetch and clear Vitest mocks; they cannot retain a remote mutation across a crash. The repaired scoped harness uses an isolated real SQLite journal/scheduler and separate remote-ledger namespace for controlled scenarios, exercises a fresh-runtime observation/recovery action, and refuses to turn cleanup or restart into completion.

Helpers at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:127-158 feed a raw private key and mutable legacy Order/Contract into init/place. The repair builds explicit AccountScope, InstrumentId, deployment, and action values, leaving one compatibility projection only; missing scope or native identity now fails before an effect.

The config/lifecycle tests at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:162-189 accept a valid key after one getChainId probe and assert id/label only. The repaired readiness reduction requires endpoint, address-set, schema, catalog, and scope evidence; a testnet/live mismatch or missing scope yields a typed degraded/blocked capability rather than initialized=true.

searchContracts at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:191-217 proves only uppercase substring matches and empty results; pairs.ts:29-33 records 20/23 coverage, :8-10/:41-43 marks 500BTC/500ETH pairBase placeholders, and :62-68 aliases testnet to mainnet. The repair preserves discovery but emits coverage/evidence states and blocks each unverified placeholder from native writes.

The known round-trip and FAKE/USD expectation at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:219-239 show that unknown text is synthesized into a Contract. The repaired resolver carries pairBase/feed evidence as Verified/Placeholder/Unknown, returns UnknownInstrument or unverified binding without a native effect, and keeps known/placeholder Contract views read-only; FAKE/USD therefore cannot reach Pyth or relayer effects.

The place validation tests at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:241-267 cover non-MKT, unknown pair, and UNSET quantity only. The repaired action model adds explicit Units versus Notional, scope, protection, relation, time/session, and deployment checks, while retaining zero-effect early failures and treating MKT as a contextual candidate rather than globally admitted.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:269-301 asserts only mocked 60000 Pyth/inputHash/binary assembly, not native deduplication, retention, accepted schema, or finality. The repaired plan uses local commandId+payloadDigest journal identity, one DispatchStarted/Observe path, and Ack only; unresolved native semantics remain unavailable.

The 503 test at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:303-313 requires success=false and an error string, although a POST may have crossed the remote boundary. The repaired phase ADT distinguishes pre-send transport failure from post-DispatchStarted Unknown, preserves redacted status/body evidence, and lets FailurePolicy continue only on separately proven terminal rejection.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:315-359 covers pair/no-position and one submitted inputHash but ignores quantity and native partial-close semantics. The repaired close leaf maps omitted legacy quantity to explicit All because the native request has no amount field, rejects supplied quantity as an absent Units leaf before POST, requires complete scoped positionHash evidence, and waits for residual-exposure observation.

The modify/cancel tests at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:361-375 pin false/error strings, which cannot distinguish unsupported capability from target/version or transport failure. The repair keeps no remote mutation but returns typed UnsupportedModify/UnsupportedCancel with target scope/version preserved and forbids cancel-and-replace masquerading as cancellation.

getQuote tests at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:377-391 assert a Number-derived Pyth price as bid=ask=last and only generic throw for unknown pair. The repaired QuoteObservation preserves integer/exponent, feed, confidence, source/as-of and freshness, uses explicit QuoteShape MarkOnly|TwoSided plus VolumeKnown|VolumeUnavailable, and keeps unknown/stale/malformed failures distinct.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:393-431 proves only a six-decimal balance and one known long row; it does not establish fee currency/scale. The repaired snapshot retains raw FeeEvidence/FeeUnitUnknown, keeps source streams separate, and never subtracts unqualified fees or synthesizes zero.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:433-471 toggles an in-memory map from Submitted to Filled using booleans and returns null for an unknown key, without proving retention or finality. The repair uses durable lookup descriptors, conservative Acked/StillWorking/Unknown classification, and requires execution/fill evidence for terminal projections.

The capability tests at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:473-486 assert static CRYPTO_PERP/MKT and always-open. The repaired snapshot treats those as source-declared compatibility metadata, gates actual use by scope/deployment/instrument/schema evidence, and makes missing session data SessionUnknown; LIMIT/protection/partial close are unavailable instead of coerced.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:488-552 proves nested/flat open signatures differ and close bytes happen to match, not which primary type the relayer accepts. The repaired immutable SchemaCapability binds one variant before prepare and forbids alternate-schema retry after DispatchStarted or ambiguity.

The decimal vectors at LeverupBroker.spec.ts:556-567 pin 10/18/6 scales but do not test signs, finite values, precision loss, or uint widths. The repair retains the exact valid integers, requires a recorded scale/token/rounding policy, and gives concrete rejection for 11 fractional digits, non-finite/negative/zero, and overflow inputs.

LeverupBroker.spec.ts:569-575 and eip712.ts:121-124 prove bytes32 formatting from Date.now/Math.random, not native deduplication or salt retention. The repair makes local nonce replay durable and keeps post-dispatch ambiguity on the same observation identity without claiming a relayer guarantee.

LeverupBroker.ts:1-9 is a role comment only; it supplies no protocol/schema, idempotency, status, finality, reader-coverage, or fee authority. The repaired manifest makes each field evidence-bound and leaves native gaps Unavailable/Unknown while exposing only safe read/degraded facts.

LeverupBroker.ts:11-65 imports legacy SDK contracts/orders and a concrete PrivateKeyAccount alongside native helpers. The repaired adapter-edge split names `LegacyContractProjectionCodec` and `LeverupWireCodec`, keeping SDK/client/key values out of the kernel and serialized plan.

OrderTrackingRecord at LeverupBroker.ts:69-78 is an in-memory inputHash map with pair/side/Decimal qty and coarse statuses. The repaired durable DispatchRecord/Attempt/Observation carries scope, canonical instrument, plan digest, schema/deployment, lease epoch, lookup descriptor and raw evidence; a boolean cannot produce Filled without execution/fill facts.

configSchema/fromConfig at LeverupBroker.ts:83-96 regex-checks and casts a raw privateKey from Record<string, unknown>. The repair makes canonical CredentialRef distinct from legacy raw-key syntax (validated and discarded only at the compatibility edge), binds deployment/scope evidence, and retains no key in broker state, plans, logs, or receipts.

The constructor/state at LeverupBroker.ts:100-128 co-locates config, nullable clients, account, initialized flag, mutable schemaVariant, and orderTracking. The repair splits immutable adapter identity, scoped runtime resources, and writer-owned durable execution; dropping runtime yields typed NotReady while old dispatch evidence remains recoverable.

LeverupBroker.ts:132-150 derives a signer, creates clients, probes only public RPC chainId, sets initialized, and logs the address. The repaired initializer requires separate endpoint/address/scope/schema evidence; until then it yields degraded/read-only capability and never write admission.

traderAddress at LeverupBroker.ts:152-155 is a bare account.address reused for reader and native trader fields. The repaired ResolvedAccountScope binds AccountId+SubAccountId, wallet address, deployment and scope revision, so observations and requests cannot cross scopes or default a missing subaccount.

close at LeverupBroker.ts:157-159 is an async no-op because viem exposes no explicit close. The repair makes scope finalization stop admission/claims, drain or classify fibers, and preserve durable Started/Unknown jobs; it never translates shutdown into remote cancellation or erases evidence.

ensureInit at LeverupBroker.ts:161-165 collapses credential, network, scope, recovery, and capability causes into BrokerError(CONFIG). The repaired typed readiness check returns the specific blocked variant before Pyth/relayer effects, while a quote-only degraded runtime remains usable only for its declared read capability.

searchContracts/getContractDetails at LeverupBroker.ts:169-190 use a static list, substring/exact text, and null/empty outcomes. The repair adds versioned catalog coverage and Known/Ambiguous/Unknown/Unavailable results with pairBase/feed/deployment provenance; a partial registry cannot prove absence or write support.

pairToContract at LeverupBroker.ts:192-203 forces every category into CRYPTO_PERP and emits only display/quote/description fields; pairs.ts:8-10/:41-43 also marks 500BTC/500ETH pairBase placeholders. The repaired canonical InstrumentDescriptor preserves venue/category/synthetic-perp and jurisdiction evidence plus Verified/Placeholder/Unknown native identity, so CRYPTO_PERP/LEVERUP remains a read-only projection and placeholders cannot compile natively.

resolvePair at LeverupBroker.ts:205-209 picks localSymbol or symbol and exact-matches static data, returning undefined on a miss; it has no coverage or deployment identity. The repair resolves canonical/native/display input variants with explicit Verified/Placeholder/Unknown binding state, reports ambiguity/unknown/unavailable, and prevents a placeholder descriptor from entering a native effect.

placeOrder validation at LeverupBroker.ts:213-227 checks initialized, MKT, pair, and only UNSET_DECIMAL before effects. The repaired pipeline validates explicit scope, action variants, finite positive quantity, units, protection/relations, session, deployment/schema capability, and preconditions; old MKT/unknown/UNSET no-HTTP behavior remains a compatibility vector.

LeverupBroker.ts:229-256 reads one Number Pyth price, hardcodes USDC/LVUSD, assumes USD and 1x, and encodes absent TP/SL as zero. The repair requires per-pair collateral/leverage/protection evidence plus explicit preconditions, ConflictKey, CommitCriterion, and CompensationCapability; unknown native mapping/undo remains unavailable or None(reason), never a guessed reversible write.

LeverupBroker.ts:258-274 creates an implicit salt/deadline and signs mutable nested/flat input, while the live accepted variant/version is absent. The repaired signing model freezes one evidence-bound schema/domain, uses OpenNonce only on OpenSigningIntent, uses close positionHash/deadline without an open nonce, and routes ambiguity to observation/recovery rather than a variant switch.

LeverupBroker.ts:276-317 posts before durable intent, stores only Submitted in a Map, and catches every error as success=false. The repair writes one epoch-fenced DispatchStarted identity and one durable ObserveJob; native duplicate/retention/lookup behavior remains explicitly unclaimed.

modifyOrder/cancelOrder at LeverupBroker.ts:319-325 always return text false, including a cancel-and-replace suggestion. The repaired action/capability boundary returns explicit UnsupportedModify/UnsupportedCancel before DispatchStarted, preserves target/version/protection/relation fields, and makes no cancellation or future support claim.

LeverupBroker.ts:327-374 selects the first pairBase row, ignores _quantity, signs/posts immediately, and does not track inputHash. The repaired close-all leaf maps omitted quantity to explicit All because the native endpoint has no amount, rejects supplied quantity as absent Units before dispatch, requires complete scoped positionHash evidence, and keeps Ack pending until residual-exposure observation.

LeverupBroker.ts:378-414 combines balance/page-0 positions, hardcodes six-decimal USD aggregation, subtracts unqualified fee strings, and sets realizedPnL to zero. The repair preserves separate source observations and exposes Partial/Unavailable valuation until native fee/net-liquidation evidence exists.

LeverupBroker.ts:416-448 silently drops unknown pair rows, treats entry as market price and margin as market value, and zeros PnL; reader pagination/fee units are not proven. The repair retains rows and raw units with coverage-aware Partial/Unavailable outcomes and no fabricated valuation.

LeverupBroker.ts:450-492 trusts an in-memory map, maps executed/success to Filled/Inactive, swallows GET errors, and treats a missing key as null. The repaired durable listing/lookup keeps incomplete namespaces Partial, failed status Unknown, and terminal states gated by native evidence.

LeverupBroker.ts:494-514 duplicates a Pyth mark into bid/ask and reports volume 0; no source feed or freshness/session/finality policy validates those fields. The repaired quote exposes exact mark through QuoteShape=MarkOnly with VolumeUnavailable unless two-sided evidence exists, and rejects stale or malformed write prerequisites.

LeverupBroker.ts:516-518 returns isOpen=true from a local Date with no calendar source. The repaired MarketSession requires versioned calendar evidence; absent evidence is SessionUnknown and blocks RegularOnly/ExtendedAllowed writes.

LeverupBroker.ts:522-527 emits static CRYPTO_PERP/MKT arrays without scope, instrument, deployment, schema, or revision evidence. The repaired capability snapshot treats them as compatibility metadata and keeps each unproven write feature Unavailable.

getNativeKey/resolveNativeKey at LeverupBroker.ts:531-547 synthesize a CRYPTO_PERP Contract for unknown text, while pairs.ts:8-10/:41-43 contains placeholder 500BTC/500ETH pairBase values. The repaired deployment-scoped resolver returns UnknownInstrument/CatalogUnavailable or NativeBindingUnverified, carries evidence state in the descriptor, and keeps Contract reconstruction read-only; neither FAKE/USD nor a placeholder can become a native target.

_account at LeverupBroker.ts:551-555 exports the concrete PrivateKeyAccount after ensureInit. The repair replaces it with a constrained SignerPort/SignerAddressEvidence binding intent to scope and plan digest; credentials remain inside the effect and rotation does not mint a new AccountId.

LeverupBroker.ts:557-560 mutates the active nested/flat signer choice, while live relayer acceptance is undocumented. The repaired immutable SchemaCapability selects one variant before prepare, persists its fingerprint, and sends post-start ambiguity to observation rather than fallback.

LeverupBroker.ts:562-566 exposes raw reader records after only ensureInit; reader-client.ts:59-90 has page counters but only fetches page 0 and does not define fee units. The repaired private ReaderPort validates declared pages/cursors, retains raw fee evidence, and exposes only Complete/Partial/Unavailable listings.
